Requirements: R-4, R-12
Plan row: TS-14

## Given
A guest with 2 books in the cart; the stand user signed out.

## Steps
1. Sign in; read the cart page and the badge.
2. Change one quantity; sign out; sign in again; read the cart and the badge.
3. Repeat sign-in with an empty guest cart.

## Then
1. After the first sign-in both guest books are in the account cart (R-4) and the badge equals the sum of quantities.
2. P-second-signin: after sign-out and sign-in the cart is the one Q4 gives, with nothing doubled.
3. P-emptyguest: sign-in with an empty guest cart leaves the account cart as it was.
